dependency: Task 206 runner output, port 8012 fifty-three-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 207 publish automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Ham House and Garden
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Ham House and Garden at Ham Street, Richmond, TW10 7RS as a rare 17th-century house surrounded by restored formal gardens and visitor facilities.
features.classification_finding: The principal standalone house is authoritative, but the tracked visitor property includes gardens, cafe, shop and wider landscape. The main house must be isolated and the ordinary Detached Home taxonomy reviewed against heritage visitor use.

features.name: Bluewater Shopping Centre
features.official_source_evidence: The official Bluewater site identifies more than 250 shops, dining and entertainment uses and publishes Bluewater Parkway, Dartford, Greenhithe DA9 9ST.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. Exact centre geometry must exclude the 13,000-space parking estate, access roads and unrelated surrounding land.

features.name: Wood Wharf
features.official_source_evidence: Canary Wharf Group is the primary developer and portfolio source for Wood Wharf; current authoritative records identify homes, offices, retail, restaurants, amenities and public spaces across the neighbourhood.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is strongly supported, but Wood Wharf is a multi-building neighbourhood rather than one Mixed Building. A named building or defensible parcel must be selected before geometry binding.

features.name: Liverpool Waters
features.official_source_evidence: The official Liverpool Waters site describes five neighbourhoods containing residential, business, hotel, retail, leisure, restaurants, cafes and public-realm uses across the dockland regeneration scheme.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is authoritative, but Liverpool Waters is a broad multi-neighbourhood regeneration programme rather than one Mixed Building. A completed named building or exact parcel is required.

features.name: Newfoundland
features.official_source_evidence: Canary Wharf Group is the primary developer source; authoritative building and planning records identify Newfoundland as a completed high-rise residential building with build-to-rent apartments and limited linked retail or podium components.
features.classification_finding: Apartment Building is strongly supported for the residential tower. Exact binding must isolate the tower and handle the linked low-rise retail or podium component explicitly.

features.name: Magna Park Lutterworth
features.official_source_evidence: GLP identifies Magna Park Lutterworth as Europe's largest dedicated logistics park with more than 13.7 million square feet of logistics warehouse space across 50 buildings and publishes individual available units.
features.classification_finding: Industrial and logistics use is authoritative, but the park is not one Industrial Unit. One named warehouse such as MPS 187, MPS 10 or another exact unit must be selected before geometry binding.
